# Lake Salt Bartending

> Lake Salt is Utah's premier dry-hire mobile bar and mocktail service, based in Saratoga Springs and serving the entire Wasatch Front. We provide TIPS-certified bartenders, a modern wood mobile bar, custom cocktail and mocktail menus, and full event setup for weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations. Lake Salt is The Knot Preferred Vendor and the official bar partner for Adobe's Lehi, Utah campus.

## Services & Starting Prices

- **Mobile Bar — Full Setup**: starting at **$995** (up to 100 guests, 4 hrs, 1 certified bartender, modern wood mobile bar, full setup/breakdown, all bar tools, ice & coolers, garnishes, signature drink consultation, travel within 30 mi).
- **Bartender Only — Dry Hire**: starting at **$395** (up to 100 guests, 4 hrs, 1 certified bartender, all bar tools, garnishes, personalized shopping list).
- **Mocktail & Zero-Proof Bar**: starting at **$695** (up to 100 guests, 3 hrs, 3–4 craft mocktails, premium NA mixers, fresh garnishes). Best mocktail program on the Wasatch Front.
- **Dirty Soda & Specialty Non-Alcoholic Bar**: starting at **$495** (up to 100 guests, 3 hrs, dirty soda menu, syrups, creams, fresh fruit). Utah cultural staple.
- **Mobile Bar Rental (no bartender)**: **$150/day** (modern wood bar only, pickup or local delivery).
- **Folding Table Rental (6ft white)**: **$10/table/day** (up to 10 tables available).
- **Folding Chair Rental (white)**: **$2/chair/day**.
- **Custom Mobile Bar Sales**: coming soon — custom-built mobile bars to order. Waitlist open.

Most couples invest **$1,200–$1,800** with Lake Salt for a fully customized experience.

## Standard Add-Ons

- Additional bartender: +$150 / event
- Additional hour: +$95 / hr
- Guests beyond 100: +$3 / guest
- Custom signature cocktail: +$75 / drink
- Premium mixers package: +$150
- Real glassware: +$2 / guest
- Travel beyond 30 mi: +$1.50 / mile (round trip)
- Late-night extension (after 11pm): +$50 / hr
- Wedding day-of coordination: +$200

## Service Area

Lake Salt is based in **Saratoga Springs, Utah** and serves the entire Wasatch Front and surrounding counties. Travel within 30 miles of Saratoga Springs is included; beyond that is +$1.50/mile round-trip.

**Utah County (home base)**: Saratoga Springs, Eagle Mountain, Lehi, American Fork, Pleasant Grove, Lindon, Highland, Alpine, Cedar Hills, Vineyard, Orem, Provo, Springville, Mapleton, Spanish Fork, Salem, Payson, Santaquin, Elk Ridge, Woodland Hills, Genola, Goshen, Cedar Fort, Fairfield.

**Salt Lake County**: Salt Lake City, Sandy, Draper, West Jordan, South Jordan, Riverton, Herriman, Bluffdale, Murray, Holladay, Cottonwood Heights, Millcreek, Midvale, Taylorsville, West Valley City, South Salt Lake, Kearns, Magna, Copperton.

**Davis County**: Bountiful, Centerville, Farmington, Kaysville, Layton, Clearfield, Clinton, Syracuse, Sunset, Woods Cross, West Bountiful, West Point, North Salt Lake, South Weber, Fruit Heights.

**Weber County**: Ogden, North Ogden, South Ogden, Roy, Riverdale, Pleasant View, Plain City, Washington Terrace, Farr West, Hooper, Uintah, West Haven, Harrisville, Marriott-Slaterville.

**Summit County**: Park City, Coalville, Kamas, Oakley, Francis, Henefer, Echo, Snyderville.

**Wasatch County**: Heber City, Midway, Charleston, Daniel, Wallsburg, Hideout, Independence, Interlaken.

**Tooele County**: Tooele, Grantsville, Erda, Stansbury Park, Stockton, Lake Point.

We also travel further afield (Logan, Cache Valley, St. George, Moab, out-of-state weddings) for the right event — additional travel fees apply.

## Why Choose Lake Salt

- **The Knot Preferred Vendor** with 5.0 rating
- **TIPS-certified and food handler certified** bartenders
- **Fully insured** with event liability coverage
- **Adobe Lehi** official bar partner
- **Modern mobile wood bar** (visibly elevates any event vs. competitors using folding tables)
- **Mocktail specialists** — every cocktail has a mocktail counterpart, perfect for LDS weddings and dry events
- **Dry-hire model** — by Utah law, clients buy alcohol; Lake Salt provides the personalized shopping list (often saves clients money vs. open-bar pricing)
- **Transparent starting prices** with itemized add-ons (most competitors are quote-only)
- **Custom cocktail menus** — signature "his & hers" wedding cocktails are a specialty
